summary: myseliasan's control plane now discovers, adopts and manages mypintusan door-controller nodes (node kind "door") alongside its existing mymatasan camera nodes and myiotsan sensor-hub nodes. The frontend gains tri-state node-kind handling (nodeKindOf/isDoorNode/isCameraNode in layout.js) and a new embedded management surface -- components/nodedoor/ -- that mirrors mypintusan's own real Doors/People/Activity/Readers/Settings pages inside myseliasan's shell, driven over the command tunnel via a new @mypintusan webpack alias and scoped CSS, exactly like the existing nodecam/nodeiot embeds (the node's own fleet-pairing panel is deliberately excluded from the embed, since unpairing from inside the tunnel would sever the tunnel it runs over). Door nodes get their own pill/chip styling, appear correctly in the nodes list, node settings dialog (details-only, same as a sensor hub), fleet-rule kind list/labels/chips, and the fleet map's inspector/asset browser/building editor; a latent bug where the fleet-map node popup fetched /proxy/api/cameras for non-camera nodes (guaranteed 404, noisy node log) is fixed for both existing kinds as a side effect. Fleet rules can now be scoped to a door node kind, and the correlator's flagship cross-domain rule (motion + door opening + no badge) is verified end-to-end against a real door node: a badge accepted (category access.granted) disarms an armed rule within its grace window, a badge denied does not, and a door-scoped absence clause ignores an access.granted-shaped event from a different node kind. Severity heuristics for bare (non-notification) node event frames now also recognize the door-alarm vocabulary (duress/forced/tamper) as Critical.
compatibility: Backward compatible. Existing camera and IoT nodes are unaffected -- node kind resolution still defaults an empty/unrecognized kind to "camera" so nothing adopted before this change changes behavior. The fleet-map camera-popup fix only removes an unnecessary failing request for non-camera nodes; it does not change what is displayed. No schema or config changes; a door node only appears once an operator actually adopts one.
